subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should browser Talk treat any usable OpenAI API-key/OAuth/Codex auth as Realtime-ready, or require an explicit realtime readiness/preflight result before enabling the microphone button?
rationale: Current main intentionally added OAuth/Codex fallback for OpenAI Realtime, while this issue asks for the UI to avoid starting the OpenAI WebRTC path when Realtime is not intentionally configured or available; both are plausible product rules and automation should not choose between them.

options.title: Require explicit readiness before capture
options.body: Use `talk.catalog` or provider preflight readiness to disable the Talk button or show a setup message before requesting microphone access.

options.title: Keep implicit auth readiness
options.body: Document that OpenAI API-key/OAuth/Codex auth makes browser Talk available and improve only the provider error text after SDP/session failures.

options.title: Move browser Talk behind explicit config
options.body: Require `talk.realtime.provider` or equivalent admin-configured defaults before the Control UI exposes the Talk start action.

recommendation.title: Require explicit readiness before capture
recommendation.body: Use `talk.catalog` or provider preflight readiness to disable the Talk button or show a setup message before requesting microphone access.

likelyOwner.reason: Available history shows the broadest ownership of Talk/gateway and OpenAI realtime provider boundaries, making this the best routed product/API decision owner among the likely owners.
